text: Hello everyone, good to meet you again.Today we are going to deal with the writing section.By the end of this lesson, you are expected to1.Identify the main content and the features of language in the sample writing.Write about an impressive place with enough details using appropriate format.Before class, please get your textbook and worksheet ready.Now, let's get started.As we all know, travelling adds colour to the daily routine of everyday life,especially when we visit an impressive place.We can't wait to share our travelling experience with others.So, what will you do if you have been to an impressive place?You may want to tell your friends about it on the phone,or share some nice photos on the Internet.So, why not write a travel blog to describe and share a more complete and more detailed travelling experience?Do you have an impression of what a travel blog is?A travel blog is usually written by someone to share the stories,pictures and tips about the places they have visited.People who write such blogs regularly are called travel bloggers.Some professional travel bloggers can even make a living doing that.We've learnt how to write a travel blog,and today we are going to explore how to describe an impressive place in it.First, do you still remember the content that we generally include in a travel blog?Here are some questions to help you recall.Now, read the travel blog on page 16 and answer the three questions.You will have two minutes.Now, let's check the answers.旅行博物馆介绍红村,是一个小传统的乡村。在旅行博物馆结束后,写文章提到南湖的美丽景色,家庭和大棵树,还介绍一些历史、传统和习惯的事实。所以,旅行博物馆的内容应该介绍地点,景色,历史,传统和习惯。那么,旅行程序如何?写文章描述旅行程序,即是时间的时刻。此外,旅行博物馆也把最有趣的部分设置为一个单字。你知道原因吗?想一想吧。旅行博物馆我们知道,这篇文章的目的就是与其他人分享写文章的令人印象深刻的旅行经历。因此,最有趣的部分旅行博物馆的目的就是与其他人分享写文章的令人印象深刻的旅行经历。现在,你能找到任何语言的特征来展示书写文章的印象深刻的旅行经历吗?这里有些问题想帮助你。你将有一分钟。在与其他人分享写文章的最有趣的部分我们知道这篇文章的目的是与其他人分享写文章的与其他人分享的与其他人分享的是与其他人分享的你将在写文章的最有趣的部分Nabachu had found several structures, an adverb followed by an adjective, to describe the place, such asa really beautiful view of Nanhu, a particularly nice postcard, extremely wealthy salt and silk traders, and that's totally different.In addition, the writer also used metaphor to describe the impressively beautiful town, such as the title, a town like a traditional painting,and the sentence in the last paragraph, the town really looks like something out of a traditional Chinese painting, which echoes the title and the theme of the article.For the language used to describe the writer's feelings, the structure, an adverb followed by an adjective, is also widely used in the article.For example, the writer felt the scenery was truly unforgettable, that the ordinary people's houses there were quite comfortable, and that the customs behind the two trees at the town gate was a really interesting part of the tour.Besides, colloquial exclamations,口語化感嘆, are also used in the article.And I wasn't, in the first paragraph, emphasizes the writer's strong sense of satisfaction with the tour.Go and check it out yourself, in the last paragraph, calls on the readers to visit Hongcun.Now, before we move on, let's have a quick review of what we have learned.When we are writing about an impressive place, we should start with creating an appealing title, grab the reader's attention with an emotional change in the first paragraph, and then describe the travel process in chronological order and with enough details, including the content of destination, scenery, history, tradition, customs, so on and so forth.You may set the most interesting part as a single paragraph.Finally, don't forget to make a conclusion and echo the theme.Moreover, you may use these language skills to show the impressiveness of the place.So, if you are to work out a checklist for it, what items will you include?You will have the next 30 seconds to think about it.Thank you for watching.Time is up.For me, I will ask myself these questions before writing about an impressive place.Do the title and the first paragraph grab the reader's attention?Is the travelling experience described in chronological order and with enough details?Is the most impressive part of the tour emphasized?Are these language skills used to describe the place and feelings?Well, class, it's your turn.Suppose you would like to write about an impressive place for the writing competition.Here is the requirement.You must have been to a lot of places in the past years, but what's the most impressive one you have been to?Please send us your description of the place.Before writing, think about these questions.Which kind of place would you like to write about?Which aspects would you like to focus on?Think for a while.
